title: recordsAt: a per-file ENOENT must not empty the whole directory snapshot (DEC-282 (a19) item 2)
description: DEC-282 (a19) item 2, option A (opum-doc ruling, relayed by the leader): fix the per-file ENOENT hazard in recordsAt for the NEXT pair release; no 0.15.2. Hazard (found while diagnosing QCLI-582, unmeasured as the cause of that failure): recordsAt in src/application/tasks/local-task-repository.ts (:286-306 at v0.15.1) lists a directory with readdir, then readFile per .json inside one Promise.all, and its catch turns ANY ENOENT (:302-304) into an empty list for the WHOLE directory. One listed file removed between readdir and readFile therefore makes every record in that directory read as absent, and findTask then throws task_not_found. A whole-directory ENOENT (the directory itself is missing) correctly returns an empty list and must keep doing so. Open design choice for the implementer, to be justified in the notes: skip only the vanished file, or retry the snapshot once. Scope note: line 280 has a similar ENOENT return; check whether it is the same hazard before touching it. Do not implement until dispatch-floor and the leader GO.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A readFile ENOENT on one listed record file no longer empties the directory: either only that file is skipped, or the snapshot is retried once; the choice is stated and justified in the task notes
A readdir ENOENT (the directory itself absent) still returns an empty list, as before
A test removes one .json between readdir and readFile and passes with the fix, and the same test fails against the pre-fix recordsAt
bun run check exits 0 on the pinned bun
